name: AuctionQueryThrottle
author: brues-code
description: A tiny DLL for World of Warcraft 1.12.1 that makes auction-house searches fast. Vanilla forces a fixed 5-second wait between AH searches; this lets the next one fire the moment the server answers — so paging through the auction house runs at round-trip speed (a fraction of a second on a healthy connection).
